log_enabled.description: Enable logging to tack.log (corresponds to -l flag)

no_init.description: Inhibit terminal initialization strings (corresponds to -i flag)

override_caps.description: Override terminfo basic function translations (corresponds to -t flag)

term_name.description: Specific terminfo terminal name to test. Empty uses $TERM

debug_file.description: Filename for debug output (corresponds to -d flag)

enquire_string.description: The ENQ sequence sent to terminal for pad timing handshake (u9)

acknowledge_string.description: The ACK sequence expected from terminal for pad timing handshake (u8)
